classes.name: account
classes.label: account
classes.definition: container for records associated with a business arrangement for regular transactions and services

classes.name: account as an asset
classes.label: account as an asset
classes.definition: financial asset in the form of an account

classes.name: account holder
classes.label: account holder
classes.definition: party that owns an account

classes.name: account identifier
classes.label: account identifier
classes.definition: identifier that denotes an account

classes.name: account ownership
classes.label: account ownership
classes.definition: holding of an account

classes.name: account provider
classes.label: account provider
classes.definition: party that provides and services an account

classes.name: account-specific service agreement
classes.label: account-specific service agreement
classes.definition: service-agreement that is account-specific, applicable in cases where a client might hold multiple accounts with differing terms and conditions

classes.name: account statement
classes.label: account statement
classes.definition: periodic summary of account activity for a given period of time

classes.name: accounting transaction
classes.label: accounting transaction
classes.definition: event recognized by an entry in the records of an account

classes.name: balance
classes.label: balance
classes.definition: amount of money available or owed

classes.name: bank account identifier
classes.label: bank account identifier
classes.definition: identifier that identifies a demand deposit account provided by a bank

classes.name: bank identifier
classes.label: bank identifier
classes.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies the financial institution and, when appropriate, the branch of that financial institution servicing an account

classes.name: basic bank account identifier
classes.label: basic bank account identifier
classes.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies an individual account at a specific financial institution in a particular country and which includes a bank identifier of the financial institution servicing that account

classes.name: brokerage account
classes.label: brokerage account
classes.definition: account offered by a broker that allows the investor to deposit funds and place investment orders

classes.name: certificate of deposit
classes.label: certificate of deposit
classes.definition: cash instrument associated with a time deposit account that cannot be withdrawn for a certain period of time (term)

classes.name: chart of accounts
classes.label: chart of accounts
classes.definition: structured system of financial account codes used to classify, record, and organize an entity's financial transactions in accordance with applicable legal, regulatory, and reporting requirements

classes.name: close date
classes.label: close date
classes.definition: date on which something was closed

classes.name: commercial lending service
classes.label: commercial lending service
classes.definition: service involving the extension of credit to support business activities

classes.name: customer account
classes.label: customer account
classes.definition: account that represents an identified, named collection of balances and cumulative totals used to summarize customer transaction-related activity over a designated period of time

classes.name: customer account holder
classes.label: customer account holder
classes.definition: party that owns a customer account

classes.name: demand deposit account
classes.label: demand deposit account
classes.definition: non-interest-bearing deposit account in which deposits are payable immediately on demand, or that are issued with an original maturity or required notice period of less than seven days, or that represent funds for which the depository institution does not reserve the right to require at least seven days' written notice of an intended withdrawal

classes.name: deposit account
classes.label: deposit account
classes.definition: account that provides a record of money placed with a depository institution for safekeeping and management

classes.name: fee
classes.label: fee
classes.definition: charge for services performed

classes.name: general ledger
classes.label: general ledger
classes.definition: organized collection of ledger accounts used to record and summarize changes in position as transactions are posted during an accounting period

classes.name: individual transaction
classes.label: individual transaction
classes.definition: event that has a monetary impact and is documented in the records associated with an account

classes.name: international bank account identifier
classes.label: international bank account identifier
classes.definition: identifier for a bank account that is an expanded version of the basic bank account number (BBAN), intended for use internationally

classes.name: investment account
classes.label: investment account
classes.definition: account that provides a record of deposits of funds and/or securities held at a financial institution

classes.name: investment or deposit account
classes.label: investment or deposit account
classes.definition: account associated with a product or service that requires the account holder to provide funds for management by the account provider

classes.name: ledger account
classes.label: ledger account
classes.definition: individual record for one element or sub-element in a ledger that records and summarizes increases, decreases, and balances associated with that specific element

classes.name: ledger account classifier
classes.label: ledger account classifier
classes.definition: classifier used to organize an entity's financial accounts in accordance with applicable legal, regulatory, and reporting requirements

classes.name: lending officer
classes.label: lending officer
classes.definition: corporate officer that has overarching responsibility for the relationship with a specific borrower or account

classes.name: loan or credit account
classes.label: loan or credit account
classes.definition: account associated with a service in which the account holder receives funds from the account provider under certain terms and conditions for repayment

classes.name: non-transaction deposit account
classes.label: non-transaction deposit account
classes.definition: any deposit account that is not explicitly considered a transaction account

classes.name: open date
classes.label: open date
classes.definition: date on which something was created

classes.name: payment due date
classes.label: payment due date
classes.definition: date by which payment of the current outstanding balance, part thereof, or a minimum amount due must be made to the creditor

classes.name: posting date
classes.label: posting date
classes.definition: date that determines in which posting period a document or journal entry is added to an account record

classes.name: relationship manager
classes.label: relationship manager
classes.definition: responsible party who manages a client's account and oversees their relationship with the service provider

classes.name: time certificate of deposit account
classes.label: time certificate of deposit account
classes.definition: time deposit account that allows deposits evidenced by a negotiable or nonnegotiable instrument, or a deposit in book entry form evidenced by a receipt or similar acknowledgement issued by the bank, that provides, on its face, that the amount of such deposit is payable to the bearer, to any specified person, or to the order of a specified person, as follows: (1) on a certain date not less than seven days after the date of deposit, (2) at the expiration of a specified period not less than seven days after the date of the deposit, or (3) upon written notice to the bank which is to be given not less than seven days before the date of withdrawal.

classes.name: time deposit account
classes.label: time deposit account
classes.definition: deposit account that the depositor does not have a right, and is not permitted, to make withdrawals from within six days after the date of deposit unless the deposit is subject to an early withdrawal penalty of at least seven days' simple interest on amounts withdrawn within the first six days after deposit

classes.name: time deposit open account
classes.label: time deposit open account
classes.definition: time deposit account that allows deposits (other than time certificates of deposit) for which there is in force a written contract with the depositor that neither the whole nor any part of such deposit may be withdrawn prior to (1) the date of maturity, which shall be not less than seven days after the date of the deposit, or (2) the expiration of a specified period of written notice of not less than seven days

classes.name: transaction category
classes.label: transaction category
classes.definition: high-level classifier for an individual transaction

classes.name: transaction date
classes.label: transaction date
classes.definition: date on which a specific transaction was initiated

classes.name: transaction deposit account
classes.label: transaction deposit account
classes.definition: deposit account from which the depositor / account holder is permitted to make transfers or withdrawals by negotiable / transferable instruments, payment orders of withdrawal, telephone transfers, and so forth, and that may be accessible via an electronic device such as an automated teller machine (ATM), remote service unit (RSU), mobile device, and by debit card

classes.name: transaction identifier
classes.label: transaction identifier
classes.definition: identifier for an individual transaction associated with an account

classes.name: transaction record
classes.label: transaction record
classes.definition: record of transactions associated with an account

classes.name: transaction record identifier
classes.label: transaction record identifier
classes.definition: unique identifier for record of transactions

classes.name: transaction subcategory
classes.label: transaction subcategory
classes.definition: second-level classifier for a transaction, e.g., direct deposit, check, cash advance, withdrawal, payment, purchase, and so forth

classes.name: agency agreement
classes.label: agency agreement
classes.definition: agreement that designates a party as a registered agent to represent and act on behalf of another party in some, typically legal, financial, or medical capacity

classes.name: agent for service of process
classes.label: agent for service of process
classes.definition: registered agent (person or organization) designated by a business entity, such as a corporation, to receive legal correspondence on behalf of the business entity in the jurisdiction in which the agent's address is located

classes.name: basket
classes.label: basket
classes.definition: collection of goods, services, or other things (e.g., financial contracts) that can be purchased and sold in some marketplace

classes.name: basket constituent
classes.label: basket constituent
classes.definition: component of a basket

classes.name: broker
classes.label: broker
classes.definition: any party that acts as an intermediary between a buyer and a seller, usually charging a commission

classes.name: broker-dealer
classes.label: broker-dealer
classes.definition: any party in the business of buying and selling securities, operating as both a broker and a dealer, depending on the transaction

classes.name: catalog
classes.label: catalog
classes.definition: publication including a list of products available for sale with their descriptions and possibly prices

classes.name: contract lifecycle
classes.label: contract lifecycle
classes.definition: lifecycle of an agreement, including, but not limited to a credit agreement, financial instrument, or other formal contract, from initial stages through retirement

classes.name: contract lifecycle event
classes.label: contract lifecycle event
classes.definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of the lifecycle of an agreement

classes.name: contract lifecycle event occurrence
classes.label: contract lifecycle event occurrence
classes.definition: actual occurrence of an event during a specific stage of a specific contract lifecycle

classes.name: contract lifecycle occurrence
classes.label: contract lifecycle occurrence
classes.definition: realization of the lifecycle of a specific contract

classes.name: contract lifecycle stage
classes.label: contract lifecycle stage
classes.definition: phase in the lifecycle of an agreement

classes.name: contract lifecycle stage occurrence
classes.label: contract lifecycle stage occurrence
classes.definition: realization, from start to finish of a phase in an occurrence of a specific contract lifecycle

classes.name: dealer
classes.label: dealer
classes.definition: any party that purchases goods or services for resale and acts on their own behalf in a transaction

classes.name: exposure
classes.label: exposure
classes.definition: means by which an individual or organization is unprotected and open to damage, danger, risk of suffering a loss, or uncertainty

classes.name: exposure bearer
classes.label: exposure bearer
classes.definition: party subject to influence or risk arising from a specific contract, instrument, or arrangement

classes.name: exposure situation
classes.label: exposure situation
classes.definition: state of affairs in which some party is subject to influence or risk arising from a specific contract, instrument, or arrangement

classes.name: financial exposure
classes.label: financial exposure
classes.definition: the extent to which an individual or organization is open to risk of suffering a loss in a transaction, or with respect to some investment or set of investments, e.g., some holding; the amount one stands to lose in that transaction or investment

classes.name: financial intermediation service
classes.label: financial intermediation service
classes.definition: any financial service in which a third party (the intermediary) matches lenders and investors with entrepreneurs and other borrowers in need of capital

classes.name: financial product
classes.label: financial product
classes.definition: product provided to consumers and businesses by financial institutions such as banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, consumer finance companies, and investment companies

classes.name: financial product catalog
classes.label: financial product catalog
classes.definition: catalog of financial products and/or services available for sale with their description and other product details

classes.name: financial service
classes.label: financial service
classes.definition: service provided to consumers and businesses by financial institutions such as banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, consumer finance companies, and investment companies

classes.name: financial service provider
classes.label: financial service provider
classes.definition: functional entity either licensed to provide financial services to consumers and/or businesses or established by law to provide financial services, such as a central bank

classes.name: legal agent
classes.label: legal agent
classes.definition: any party that has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party

classes.name: licensed agent
classes.label: licensed agent
classes.definition: any individual who is licensed to perform a legally binding function, and who has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party

classes.name: offeree
classes.label: offeree
classes.definition: party that receives an offer from something from someone (i.e., an offerer) based on the terms of the offering

classes.name: offering
classes.label: offering
classes.definition: expression of interest in providing something to someone that is contingent upon acceptance, forbearance, or some other consideration, as might be desired by an offeree(s)

classes.name: offeror
classes.label: offeror
classes.definition: party that proposes to make something available to someone (i.e., an offeree) based on the terms of the offering

classes.name: position
classes.label: position
classes.definition: financial exposure resulting from owning, borrowing, shorting, or entering into a contract (e.g., derivatives)

classes.name: product lifecycle
classes.label: product lifecycle
classes.definition: lifecycle specific to a product or product family

classes.name: product lifecycle event
classes.label: product lifecycle event
classes.definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of a product lifecycle

classes.name: product lifecycle event occurrence
classes.label: product lifecycle event occurrence
classes.definition: actual occurrence of an event that happens during a specific stage of a specific product lifecycle

classes.name: product lifecycle occurrence
classes.label: product lifecycle occurrence
classes.definition: realization of the lifecycle of a specific product

classes.name: product lifecycle stage
classes.label: product lifecycle stage
classes.definition: phase in a product lifecycle

classes.name: product lifecycle stage occurrence
classes.label: product lifecycle stage occurrence
classes.definition: realization of a specific stage in the lifecycle of a given product

classes.name: registered agent
classes.label: registered agent
classes.definition: legal agent designated by some party to represent them and act on their behalf under a formal agency agreement

classes.name: regulated commodity
classes.label: regulated commodity
classes.definition: commodity under the jurisdiction of the regulatory agency, such as the Commodities Futures Trading Commission (CFTF) in the United States, which includes any commodity traded in an organized contracts market

classes.name: settlement terms
classes.label: settlement terms
classes.definition: contract terms that define the commitment to and mechanism for settling one or more sides of a transaction

classes.name: third-party agent
classes.label: third-party agent
classes.definition: any service provider that is licensed to perform a legally binding function and has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party

classes.name: trade
classes.label: trade
classes.definition: situation that realizes an agreement between parties participating in a voluntary action of buying and selling goods and services

classes.name: trade identifier
classes.label: trade identifier
classes.definition: sequence of characters identifying a trade within some context

classes.name: trade lifecycle
classes.label: trade lifecycle
classes.definition: lifecycle that defines the evolution of a trade, from initiation through settlement

classes.name: trade lifecycle event
classes.label: trade lifecycle event
classes.definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of the lifecycle of a trade

classes.name: trade lifecycle event occurrence
classes.label: trade lifecycle event occurrence
classes.definition: realization of an event that happens during a specific stage of a specific trade lifecycle

classes.name: trade lifecycle occurrence
classes.label: trade lifecycle occurrence
classes.definition: realization of the lifecycle for a specific trade

classes.name: trade lifecycle stage
classes.label: trade lifecycle stage
classes.definition: phase in the lifecycle of a trade

classes.name: trade lifecycle stage occurrence
classes.label: trade lifecycle stage occurrence
classes.definition: realization of a phase in the lifecycle of a specific trade

classes.name: trader
classes.label: trader
classes.definition: party that engages in the transfer of financial assets in any financial market on behalf of a client or the financial services provider

classes.name: trading strategy
classes.label: trading strategy
classes.definition: approach used for buying and selling in the securities markets

classes.name: unique transaction identifier
classes.label: unique transaction identifier
classes.definition: sequence of characters identifying a financial transaction uniquely whenever useful and agreed by the parties or community involved in the transaction

classes.name: weighted basket
classes.label: weighted basket
classes.definition: basket whose constituents have some relative importance with respect to one another

classes.name: weighted basket constituent
classes.label: weighted basket constituent
classes.definition: component of a basket whose relative importance with respect to other basket constituents is known

edges.name: applies to account
edges.label: applies to account
edges.definition: indicates the account to which the transaction record or individual transaction applies

edges.name: has balance
edges.label: has balance
edges.definition: relates an account to the net amount of money available in that account

edges.name: has close date
edges.label: has close date
edges.definition: relates something to the date that it was closed

edges.name: has corresponding account
edges.label: has corresponding account
edges.definition: relates a credit agreement to an account used as the basis for managing transactions

edges.name: has ending balance
edges.label: has ending balance
edges.definition: relates an account statement to the amount of money available in that account at the end of the statement period

edges.name: has open date
edges.label: has open date
edges.definition: relates something to the date that it was created

edges.name: has payment due date
edges.label: has payment due date
edges.definition: indicates the date by which payment of some amount must be made to the creditor

edges.name: has posting date
edges.label: has posting date
edges.definition: indicates the date that the transaction was posted to the account

edges.name: has primary account holder
edges.label: has primary account holder
edges.definition: relates an account to a client or customer that is considered the primary owner of the account

edges.name: has secondary account holder
edges.label: has secondary account holder
edges.definition: relates an account to a client or customer that is considered a secondary, co-owner of the account

edges.name: has starting balance
edges.label: has starting balance
edges.definition: relates an account statement to the amount of money available in that account at the beginning of the statement period

edges.name: has transaction date
edges.label: has transaction date
edges.definition: indicates the date on which the transaction actually occurred

edges.name: involves merchant
edges.label: involves merchant
edges.definition: indicates the merchant (seller) involved in the transaction

edges.name: is linked to account
edges.label: is linked to account
edges.definition: connects a given customer account to another customer account

edges.name: records transaction
edges.label: records transaction
edges.definition: links an account statement to the individual transactions it documents

edges.name: exposes in
edges.label: exposes in
edges.definition: indicates the state of affairs in which exposure occurs

edges.name: facilitates
edges.label: facilitates
edges.definition: acts as an enabler in a situation in which an event, a task, a conversation or something else occurs

edges.name: has exposed party
edges.label: has exposed party
edges.definition: indicates the party subject to influence or risk in

edges.name: has exposure to
edges.label: has exposure to
edges.definition: involves influence or risk from

edges.name: has generating entity
edges.label: has generating entity
edges.definition: specifies a legal entity that generates something

edges.name: has generating entity identifier
edges.label: has generating entity identifier
edges.definition: specifies an identifier for the entity that generated a unique transaction identifier

edges.name: has registered agent
edges.label: has registered agent
edges.definition: identifies a party as one that has the legal, medical or financial capacity to act on behalf of someone else under specific circumstances

edges.name: has offering
edges.label: has offering
edges.definition: relates something to a voluntary but conditional promise submitted by a buyer or seller (offeror) to another (offeree) for acceptance, and which becomes legally enforceable if accepted by the offeree

edges.name: has offering amount
edges.label: has offering amount
edges.definition: indicates the notional monetary amount, determined based on reference data, market rates or some other agreed method associated with some offering

edges.name: has offering price
edges.label: has offering price
edges.definition: indicates the price associated with an offering, which may be an explicit or calculated price

edges.name: has selecting party
edges.label: has selecting party
edges.definition: indicates the person(s) or organization(s) responsible for determining the contents of a basket

edges.name: has settlement date
edges.label: has settlement date
edges.definition: indicates the date by which an executed order or transaction must be settled

edges.name: has trade date
edges.label: has trade date
edges.definition: indicates the date on which a security or other instrument-specific trade actually takes place

edges.name: is embodied in
edges.label: is embodied in
edges.definition: identifies the representation or tangible form of something in some context

edges.name: is exposed party in
edges.label: is exposed party in
edges.definition: indicates the state of affairs in which the party bears the risk

edges.name: is exposed to
edges.label: is exposed to
edges.definition: is subject to influence or risk from

edges.name: is exposure of
edges.label: is exposure of
edges.definition: is the influence or risk borne by

edges.name: is facilitated by
edges.label: is facilitated by
edges.definition: identifies someone or something that expedites some event, transaction, conversation or something else in some context

edges.name: is offering of
edges.label: is offering of
edges.definition: relates an offering to one or things that are the subject of the offer

edges.name: relates to
edges.label: relates to
edges.definition: has a logical or causal connection with

attributes.name: has transaction description
attributes.label: has transaction description
attributes.definition: provides a textual description of the transaction

attributes.name: has transaction record status
attributes.label: has transaction record status
attributes.definition: indicates the status of the transaction record

attributes.name: has nominal number of units
attributes.label: has nominal number of units
attributes.definition: indicates the base number of units of something associated with some offering

attributes.name: has offering units
attributes.label: has offering units
attributes.definition: indicates the actual number of units of something, including any premium on the number of units, associated with some offering

attributes.name: has selection criteria
attributes.label: has selection criteria
attributes.definition: describes the methodology or program used to determine the membership of a collection
